name: A11y Enhancer
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
A11y Enhancer adds a dynamic accessibility widget to your WordPress site, providing basic tools to improve usability for all users. Adjust font size, contrast, enable grayscale mode, underline links, and apply accessibility profiles like Vision Impaired and Seizure Safe. The free version offers essential accessibility features, while the Pro version unlocks advanced tools.

Free Features

  • Font size adjustment (1 level)
  • Contrast adjustment (1 level)
  • Grayscale mode
  • Underline links
  • Accessibility profiles: Vision Impaired, Seizure Safe
  • Customizable widget position and styling
  • Responsive design

Pro Features (Upgrade at https://pluginjoy.com/a11y-enhancer)

  • AI-generated alt text (OpenAI integration)
  • Full WCAG 2.2 compliance reports
  • Color contrast analyzer
  • Additional profiles (ADHD Friendly, Blindness, Epilepsy Safe)
  • Text-to-speech
  • Color blindness filters
  • Advanced widget styling and device compatibility

Supported Languages

A11y Enhancer is translation-ready and supports the following languages (additional translations welcome via WordPress.org):
1. English (en_US)
2. Spanish (es_ES)
3. French (fr_FR)
4. German (de_DE)
5. Italian (it_IT)
6. Portuguese (pt_BR)
7. Dutch (nl_NL)
8. Russian (ru_RU)
9. Chinese (zh_CN)
10. Japanese (ja)
11. Arabic (ar)
12. Polish (pl_PL)
13. Swedish (sv_SE)
14. Hindi (hi_IN)
15. Korean (ko_KR)

Contribute translations at https://translate.wordpress.org/projects/wp-plugins/a11y-enhancer.

Notes

  • Requires Font Awesome for icons (ensure your theme or another plugin includes it, or add manually via CDN).
  • For Pro features, visit https://pluginjoy.com/product/a11y-enhancer-pro.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the a11y-enhancer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under “A11y Enhancer” in the admin menu.
  4. Optionally, upgrade to Pro at https://pluginjoy.com/a11y-enhancer for advanced features.
sections.faq:
What features are included in the free version?

The free version includes font size adjustment (1 level), contrast adjustment (1 level), grayscale mode, link underlining, and two accessibility profiles (Vision Impaired, Seizure Safe).

How do I access advanced features?

Upgrade to A11y Enhancer Pro at https://pluginjoy.com/a11y-enhancer for AI alt text, WCAG 2.2 reports, color contrast analysis, text-to-speech, and more.

Is the plugin translatable?

Yes, A11y Enhancer is translation-ready. Use the a11y-enhancer text domain to contribute translations via WordPress.org.

How do I customize the widget?

Go to Settings > A11y Enhancer to adjust widget position, colors, font, and other styling options. Additional customization is available in the Pro version.
